scope: PO approved finish-confirm and finished-local illustration assets, autumn only; other seasons reuse existing art

prompts.confirmation:
Asset type: production mobile illustration PNG, not a UI mockup.
Create ONLY the small autumn animal vignette inside the bottom sheet of reference Image1. Image1 is the approved NURI finish-confirmation UI concept; do NOT include ANY of its UI, map, text, panel, handle, buttons, shadows or screen frame. Image2 supplies existing NURI character identity and soft dimensional storybook rendering.
The golden dog lies resting, front paws visible, smiling with relaxed closed eyes; a gray-white cat curls against the dog's right cheek, eyes closed; a tiny yellow cockatiel perches gently on the dog's head. They rest on a shallow strip of golden and orange autumn leaves. A very few maple leaves at the far sides, no huge floating leaf. All three complete silhouettes comfortably inside a wide approximately1200x600 canvas, with enough transparent margin for ears and tail. This is a quiet post-walk moment, cute but calm, polished soft painterly/fur detail matching the reference, NOT generic vector clip art.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT background with natural soft semi-transparent leaf edges. No opaque white rectangle, no white matte, no checkerboard baked into the pixels. No backdrop trees, no extra animal, no icon, no typography of any kind, no border or card.
Keep the subject compact and legible at approximately160x80dp. Keep source canvas wide about2:1 so no image cropping will be necessary.
